questions.q: 'Rahim is taller than any other boy in the class.' — The superlative form is—
o: No boy is taller than Rahim.
Rahim is the taller boy in the class.
Rahim is the tallest boy in the class.
Rahim is as tall as any boy in the class.
questions.e: taller than any other → the tallest (superlative)।
questions.src: Lecture 01, 06–07 ও Standard English Dictionary (Oxford Learner's) ও Grammar Reference (Swan)

questions.q: 'This is one of the best books on the subject.' — The comparative form is—
o: Very few books are better than this.
This is better than any other book on the subject.
No other book is as good as this.
This is better than most other books on the subject.
questions.e: one of the best → better than most other (any other নয়)।
questions.t: one of the best → better than most other।
